Definition: Jephunneh, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jephunneh is the name of two Israelites, and the father of Caleb is the best known. In Numbers 13:6, Caleb the son of Jephunneh. The fuller story is told on the Jephunneh, Father of Caleb profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jephunneh shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
